description: Explanation model selection for #23, made on the 12 dev scenarios only and frozen before the held-out run.
baseline_kept: DeepSeek-V4-Flash was already the explanation baseline (PR #22); the candidate Qwen3.8-27B did not justify replacing it for an interactive demo.

evidence_dev.scenarios: 12 synthetic dev families, drafted by Yoshio, pending Tuong review

reasons: Qwen3.8-27B took a median 138 s per scenario and timed out twice at the 180 s client timeout, which is not usable while an engineer waits.

All 7 invalid DeepSeek drafts failed only the validator's no-digits rule by naming the asset model (e.g. PX-100); none wrote a quantity. That rule needs a #17 decision on identifiers, and it would affect any model.
DeepSeek missed both irrelevant-evidence abstentions (S05, S12); Qwen abstained on the one it completed. Expert review stays mandatory.
status: preliminary: small synthetic set, single runs; revisit after Tuong reviews the scenarios and the identifier rule
